components.goal: Form the outer direction without differentiating the finite inner trajectory.
components.key_estimate: At y*(x) the estimator equals grad Phi by #/links/0. Its pointwise inner-distance error is bounded by #/links/1 under that record's full conditions.
components.name: Implicit estimator

limitations.statement: Outer iteration complexity and finite-accuracy schedules are outside this selected record. The linked lemmas are identity/bias statements, not Algorithm performance bounds or unrestricted Oracle Complexity.
The selected inner loop restarts at fixed y0; a warm-start implementation is a distinct variant.
Source input line allows nonnegative alpha_k, but Eq.(2.6) is undefined at zero. This variant uses alpha_k>0 and asserts no zero-step extension.

variants.cost: Per outer iteration without caching: t_k lower partial-gradient g_y evaluations; one f_x and one f_y evaluation; one mixed-Hessian matrix A and one lower-Hessian matrix H evaluation; one exact m-dimensional linear solve; one multiplication A v_k; and one exact proximal/projection subproblem over X. Charge these resources separately. Matrix arithmetic, factorization, memory and projection costs depend on dimensions and implementation. No unit-cost inverse or Hessian-vector-only complexity is asserted.

variants.name: Cold-start BA with exact implicit solve
variants.output: Generated x_k in X and inner approximations ybar_k in R^m. At caller truncation N, x_N is the final outer iterate, with no averaging, randomized selection or accuracy certificate attached.
public_inputs: x0 in X and fixed y0 in R^m
Sequences alpha_k>0, beta_t>=0 and finite integers t_k>=0
An optional caller truncation N, without an accuracy guarantee
variants.query_and_update: For t=0,...,t_k-1, query g_y(x_k,y_{k,t}) and set y_{k,t+1}=y_{k,t}-beta_t g_y(x_k,y_{k,t}). Set ybar_k=y_{k,t_k}. At (x_k,ybar_k), query f_x,f_y,A,H; solve H v_k=f_y exactly and set h_k=f_x-A v_k. Set x_{k+1}=argmin_{u in X}{<h_k,u>+||u-x_k||_2^2/(2 alpha_k)}, as in Eq.(2.6).
variants.requirements: Nonempty closed convex X; exact f_x,f_y,g_y and exact A=g_xy,H=g_yy; an exact linear solve H v=f_y; exact solution of the Euclidean proximal subproblem over X. Full standing Assumptions 1–2 are recorded in src.P052, including uniform lower strong convexity H>=mu_g I, mu_g>0. No stochastic Oracle is used.
variants.state_and_initialization: Initialize x=x0 and ybar_0=y0. At each outer iteration k restart the inner loop from the same fixed y0; write y_{k,0}=y0 to disambiguate the source's reused t indices. The fixed-y0 distance in Eq.(2.13) corroborates the cold-start interpretation.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Algorithm 1 supplies input schedules and generates an infinite sequence without an intrinsic accuracy stopping rule. This runnable variant requires alpha_k>0 because Eq.(2.6) divides by alpha_k; beta_t>=0 and t_k>=0 integral. Finite N is a caller truncation. Accuracy-dependent schedules and outer convergence results are outside this selected record; arbitrary schedules have no claimed convergence.
